ffd20-bestiary-builder.sourceText: Breath Weapon (1d4+1 rounds, 60-ft. cone, DC 26, 10d6 non-elemental damage)

description.value: An adamantoise's bite attack is treated as an adamantine weapon for the purposes of damage reduction.
As a standard action, the adamantoise can inflict more pain than normal. If they succeed at hitting with their bite attack, the damage is 3d6+11 x 1.5 for total damage.

effect: One adamantine bite as a standard action, with no recharge listed.

description.value: As a full-round action, the adamantoise can leap into the air and crash to the ground, shaking the earth with his bulk; all creatures standing on the ground within 30 feet must make a Fortitude save (DC 26) or be stunned for 1d4 rounds.

effect: As a full-round action, the adamantoise can leap into the air and crash to the ground, shaking the earth with his bulk; all creatures standing on the ground within 30 feet must make a Fortitude save (DC 26) or be stunned for 1d4 rounds.

description.value: 2/day, when the adamantoise's HPs is under 50% (107 health), he may activate this ability to increase his defense and heal up at the cost of inactivity. The adamantoise receives Fast Healing 10, DR 15/-, +10 Armor Bonus, and all Elemental Resist 15 for up to 5 rounds but cannot perform any other actions. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 6th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 27).

effect: Below half HP (126 at the printed 252 maximum; the source parenthesis says 107). Up to five rounds; no other actions while sheltered.

description.value: Give to the affected target and activate after resolving the save.

effect: Apply fast healing once per round, only while in shell.
